title: 2007 Pokémon TCG World Championships
subtitle: Research notes and surviving historical sources

content.text: The 2007 World Championships records were reconstructed using surviving official webpages and archived copies of the original tournament website.
The archived standings page contained competitor names, countries, divisions, and tournament results. This information was used as the primary source for the 2007 database entries.

content.caption: Archived standings from the 2007 World Championships.

content.text: Some historical pages do not preserve enough information to determine an exact final placement. In those cases, the database records only the placement range that can be verified.

content.title: Data policy
content.text: No exact placement is inferred when the surviving source only confirms a result such as Top 32.
